name: labs/bnl-atf__ophyd-basler
title: Basler camera (ophyd-basler)
intro: Basler camera (ophyd-basler), adapted from bnl-atf/ophyd-basler. It reads `camera_model`, `serial_number`, `user_defined_name`, `image_shape` and 6 more; sets `exposure_time`; runs `capture`. `capture`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
